summary: Feeling constantly drained, sluggish, or physically exhausted despite sleeping.

nutrients.name: Iron
nutrients.role: Helps red blood cells transport oxygen throughout the body.
nutrients.pro_tip: Pair iron with Vitamin C (e.g., lemon juice) to boost absorption.

nutrients.name: Vitamin B12
nutrients.role: Crucial for nerve function and cellular energy production.
nutrients.pro_tip: If plant-based, look for B12-fortified plant milks or supplements.

summary: Involuntary muscle twitches, spasms, or sudden soreness after mild movement.

nutrients.name: Magnesium
nutrients.role: Regulates muscle contraction, relaxation, and nerve signals.
nutrients.pro_tip: Magnesium glycinate is gentle on the stomach and great for nighttime muscle relaxation.

nutrients.name: Potassium
nutrients.role: Maintains fluid balance and proper muscle/heart function.
nutrients.pro_tip: Sweating heavily depletes potassium rapidly; replenish with electrolyte-rich foods.

summary: Catching every cold that goes around or taking a long time to shake off illnesses.

nutrients.name: Vitamin D
nutrients.role: Modulates the immune system and activates pathogen-fighting cells.
nutrients.pro_tip: Your body synthesizes Vitamin D via direct sunlight on bare skin.

nutrients.name: Zinc
nutrients.role: Vital for immune cell development and fighting oxidative stress.
nutrients.pro_tip: Soaking or sprouting beans/seeds increases zinc bioavailability.

summary: Frequent abdominal swelling, discomfort, or slow gut motility after eating.

nutrients.name: Magnesium
nutrients.role: Relaxes intestinal muscles and draws water into the bowels to ease regularity.
nutrients.pro_tip: Magnesium citrate is particularly helpful if sluggish digestion is an issue.

nutrients.name: B-Complex Vitamins
nutrients.role: Supports metabolic function and the nervous system controlling gut motility.
nutrients.pro_tip: Stress depletes B vitamins quickly, which can slow down digestion.

summary: Difficulty concentrating, forgetfulness, or a sluggish mental state.

nutrients.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids (EPA/DHA)
nutrients.role: Builds brain cell membranes and reduces neuroinflammation.
nutrients.pro_tip: Plant-based omega-3s (ALA from chia/walnuts) convert poorly in the body; pair with algae oil if vegan.

nutrients.name: Vitamin B6
nutrients.role: Aids in the production of neurotransmitters like serotonin and dopamine.
nutrients.pro_tip: B6 works synergistically with magnesium to support mood and focus.

symptom: Brittle Hair, Nail Ridges & Dry Skin
summary: Hair thinning, splitting fingernails, or chronically dry, flaky skin.

nutrients.name: Biotin (Vitamin B7)
nutrients.role: Supports keratin infrastructure in hair, skin, and nails.
nutrients.pro_tip: Raw egg whites contain avidin, which binds to biotin and blocks absorption—always cook eggs!

nutrients.name: Zinc
nutrients.role: Essential for tissue repair, cellular turnover, and controlling skin oil production.
nutrients.pro_tip: Zinc deficiency is a common root cause of white spots on fingernails.
